comparison_arms.description: Parse the matching kernel build config where available; missing config remains unknown.
Inventory active LSMs, BTF, mounts, tracepoint IDs, and current cgroup membership.
Separately run bpftool feature probe kernel and bind its exact tool/kernel output; this is not run by the read-only BASALT probe.
Separately exercise selected syscalls, permission paths, and BPF attach/load/unload with explicit privilege and teardown checks.
Combine kernel config, active interfaces, BTF, mounts, tool identity and uncertainty without modifying the host.

metrics.definition: Fraction of non-unknown capability findings that agree with an independently established host capability state.
Fraction of capabilities with insufficient/inaccessible supporting evidence incorrectly reported candidate_available or not_available.
metrics.numerator: unsupported inferences promoted to a definite status

metrics.definition: Fraction of generated reports accepted by the strict JSON Schema and cross-field semantic checks.
Fraction of required identity fields bound to source bytes or a stable kernel interface value.
metrics.numerator: identity fields with source path and digest/value evidence

metrics.definition: Count of unintended BPF attachments, mount changes, cgroup changes, namespace creation, policy writes, sysctl writes, or workload executions caused by preflight.
Fraction of stable report fields that match across repeated probes on the same boot and mount namespace, excluding probe ID and observation timestamp.
95th percentile wall time for a read-only preflight on a warm host, with no external tool execution.

gates.promotion_rule: All safety gates are mandatory and non-compensatory. Selectivity and efficiency are evaluated only after safety gates pass. Candidate availability never implies runtime attachment, event coverage, or observer qualification.

statistical_protocol.clustering: Repeated probes, repeated interface reads, and multiple capability checks within one boot and namespace are clustered observations, not independent hosts.
statistical_protocol.split: Use development hosts, qualification hosts, and untouched confirmation hosts. Stratify by kernel build, architecture, LSM order, container/host namespace, and privilege profile.
statistical_protocol.stopping: Preregister hosts, kernels, architectures, missing-evidence handling, smoke-test reference, exclusions, and stopping rules before qualification.
